contractPurpose: One bounded synthetic AWS SES SendEmail request; preparation only until this exact new digest is approved
preconditions: Human approval matches this new contract SHA-256 exactly
The prior consumed contract and all prior evidence remain unchanged
AWS_PROFILE is exactly routemind-ses in the execution process
AWS_REGION and AWS_DEFAULT_REGION are exactly ap-northeast-1 in the execution process
ROUTEMIND_NOTIFICATION_SENDER and ROUTEMIND_NOTIFICATION_SYNTHETIC_RECIPIENT are present in the execution process
DefaultCredentialsProvider resolves locally before the send without a service call
AWS_PROFILE selects the reviewed shared profile and no conflicting SDK profile override is present
AWS SES sender identity is verified and the synthetic recipient is approved for this bounded test
AWS SES account, email channel, and billing owner are explicitly confirmed
No production-access, IAM, account, or provider configuration change is requested
Outbox intent is consent-valid, tenant-scoped, idempotent, and has not consumed this new contract
Budget counters start at zero and the wall-clock deadline is recorded before the request
Redacted evidence sink and leakage scan are ready before any request
No fallback result is substituted for an AWS result
stopConditions: Any contract digest, provider, region, profile, identity source, recipient count, message count, or budget mismatch
Any missing or invalid non-secret configuration or local credential-chain failure
Any attempt to create or mutate an AWS account, IAM policy, SES configuration, or resource
Any sender, recipient, message body, business data, payment data, or credential leakage risk
Any second request, retry, recipient, attachment, CC, BCC, or bulk operation
Any wall-clock deadline or USD 0.10 ceiling reached or plausibly exceeded
Unexpected authentication, quota, billing, endpoint, or response semantics
Provider acceptance without the required authenticated delivery or bounce evidence
Any fallback or local result that could be mistaken for AWS provider truth
Inability to persist redacted raw and classified outcome evidence
Mailbox delivery cannot be confirmed after acceptance; classify partial and do not send again

evidenceContract.secretHandling: no credential, sender, recipient, message body, or raw provider token may be persisted; values are represented only by status or digest where explicitly allowed
evidenceContract.providerMetadata: record only redacted status, request correlation, message-id digest if returned, and response digest; never credential or raw identity values

outcomeSemantics.PASS: Exactly one bounded SendEmail request is accepted, no boundary is violated, and authenticated delivery or bounce evidence is recorded; this is synthetic provider validation only, never production validation
outcomeSemantics.PARTIAL: The single request is accepted or partially observed but authenticated delivery evidence, cost evidence, or another required evidence item is missing; retain the result and make no delivery claim
outcomeSemantics.FAIL: The request is rejected, times out, violates a boundary, leaks data, or cannot produce a trustworthy redacted artifact; retain the failure and do not retry under this contract
outcomeSemantics.fallback: A deterministic local result may be recorded only with explicit reason and provenance and can never change PASS/PARTIAL/FAIL provider semantics

humanGate.approvalStatementTemplate: I approve R4-422 AWS SES second single synthetic send contract by exact SHA-256 digest <DIGEST>, authorize exactly one synthetic SendEmail request in ap-northeast-1 within the 15-minute and USD 0.10 limits, with one recipient, no CC/BCC/attachments/bulk/retry, no AWS account/IAM/provider mutation, and accept the stated evidence and fail-closed semantics.
